extracted.name: Easy Fruit Dip
extracted.description: An easy and delicious fruit dip to serve with anything from sliced fruit like apples or strawberries, to snacks like pretzels. Everyone loves it!
instruction_lines: Place marshmallow creme and cream cheese in a microwave-safe bowl. Place in microwave and cook on medium-high in 20 seconds increments until softened.
Stir cherry juice into marshmallow-cream cheese mixture. Cover and refrigerate until chilled.
